info.title: serena
info.description: A .NET-first MCP coding agent inspired by oraios/serena. Ships as a .NET global tool with 38 tools for navigating, understanding, and editing code. Features an indexed SQLite symbol cache, solution-scoped indexing for large repositories, lazy language-server startup, explicit Roslyn readiness/completeness telemetry, outline-first responses, and 13 language-server backends.
